rv.q: Maidment's astute direction pieces together some first-class, disparate acts that genuinely pull together as a company.
It's camp, daft, sharply delivered and absolutely oodles of fun.

cn.t: Critics rave about this stylish cabaret at Lafayette, praising its entertaining blend of comedy, dance, acrobatics, and circus elements. The show delivers exactly what it promises with talented performers and captivating indulgence.
